task.ask: a laptop backpack for work and travel

products.name: Cosmos Laptop Backpack
products.title: Cosmos Laptop Backpack
products.description: This Hedgren Cosmos laptop backpack is designed for everyday use, offering a structured silhouette and water and dust repellent material for durability. It features multiple zippered compartments, including a padded sleeve for a 13" laptop, and convenient side pockets. The double padded, adjustable shoulder straps ensure comfortable carrying, making it a practical choice for work, school, or travel.

products.name: 350 Laptop Backpack
products.title: 350 Laptop Backpack
products.description: The Perry Ellis 350 Laptop Backpack is a professional and durable business backpack designed for work and travel. It features a padded compartment capable of fitting most 15-inch laptops, along with multiple organizational pockets and compartments for accessories like chargers, mice, and pens. For added convenience during airport travel, it includes a dedicated luggage strap on the back.

products.name: UrbanEX-T77 Laptop Backpack
products.title: UrbanEX-T77 Laptop Backpack
products.description: The tomtoc UrbanEX-T77 Laptop Backpack is a 32L professional carry-on backpack designed for commuting and short business trips. It features a 180° clamshell opening for easy packing and security screening, and includes dedicated padded sleeves that securely hold up to a 16-inch laptop and a 13-inch tablet. Built for durability and comfort, it is crafted from splash-resistant 400D polyester with a reinforced 840D base, and features an EVA-padded back panel and breathable mesh shoulder straps for all-day wear.

products.name: ThinkPad Professional Laptop Backpack
products.title: ThinkPad Professional Laptop Backpack
products.description: ThinkPad Professional Laptop Backpack in black for adults, featuring a dedicated laptop compartment for up to 16 inches, multiple pockets for organization, and a spacious 18L main compartment. Made with 70% recycled PET material for durability with an eco-friendly construction. Includes a smart cable slot for on-the-go charging and a luggage strap for travel. Lenovo warranty offers limited lifetime coverage.

products.name: Samsonite Laptop Backpack
products.title: Samsonite Laptop Backpack
products.description: The Samsonite Laptop Backpack is a stylish and functional choice for work or school. Designed to fit most 15.6" laptops, it features a fully padded laptop sleeve and tablet pocket for extra security. The bag is constructed from durable 100% polyester fabric with a lining made from recycled rPET plastic bottles. It offers extensive organization with multiple zip pockets, a water bottle pocket, a hidden stash pocket for valuables, and a sunglass loop.
